priorFailedPackageAttempts.cause: Fixture omitted confirm:true, rejected by the existing config confirmation gate; corrected and reran both packages in a new directory.

Full core suite failed session-get-etag H3/F1/F2. The test shared H/F with its own asynchronous permission writer. The exact write invalidating that run was not captured, so no production ETag defect is claimed fixed.
priorFailedPackageAttempts.correction: Preserve failures and diagnostics; isolate background capabilities; require an actual conditional 304 within the existing bound; keep E/D permission coverage plus disk-head assertion and use an independent idle session for strict H/F cache checks.
